<!-- pr-reviewer: 54edd5e0b7875b023b46ed99b3acc72dc099570a -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only: 3 goldens plus one assertion in `probe_dialects.rs`; no behaviour code, build.rs, scripts, `.github/` or dependencies touched.
- I read every golden diff. Each differs from the old file only by #579's safe-plane descent and its consequences:
  - Haas: `G0 ... Z25` becomes `G0 ... Z50`, then a guarded `G31 ... Z25` with its `#5063` hit check. Nothing else changes.
  - Mazak: `G00 ... Z50`, then a guarded `G31 Z25` with `GOTO9001` and the hit alarm. The old first guard becomes 9002, and every later `GOTO`/`N` label shifts by exactly +1 (9003..9013). Nothing else changes.
  - Sinumerik: `G0 ... Z50`, then `MEAS=1 G1 ... Z25` with its `$AC_MEA` hit alarm (6 new lines). Every later block number shifts by exactly +60 (old N100 is new N160, through N1170). Nothing else changes.
- The `probe_dialects.rs` label change (9002 to 9003) matches the extra guard and carries an explanatory comment.

**Local results** (trial merge with upstream/main was clean, "Already up to date")
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test probe_dialects` | 13 passed, 0 failed |
| clippy | not run: no Rust source changed |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Only the Haas/Mazak/Sinumerik bore-centre goldens were regenerated; I did not re-run `probe_tormach`, `probe_guard` or `probe_op`, which the PR body reports as passing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
